name: suicatap_policy_gate
description: Apply your own risk policy to any Base token and receive a PASS or BLOCK verdict. Set custom thresholds: minScore (0-100), maxBuyTax (%), maxSellTax (%), minLiquidity (USD), allowHoneypot (bool). The gate checks the token against your rules and explains exactly which rule triggered a BLOCK. Ideal for DeFi agents with strict risk parameters.

minScore.description: Minimum safety score required (0-100). Default: 0 (no minimum)

maxBuyTax.description: Maximum allowed buy tax in %. Default: 100 (no limit)

maxSellTax.description: Maximum allowed sell tax in %. Default: 100 (no limit)

minLiquidity.description: Minimum liquidity in USD. Default: 0 (no minimum)

allowHoneypot.description: Whether to allow honeypot tokens. Default: false
